protocol.purpose: Posthoc human visual diagnosis of candidate generation and selection; not a new training experiment
protocol.scope: ETH existing development subset, generator seed1, 1516 explicit IDs, K20, 8 observed and 12 future steps
protocol.primary_model: Current generation-study immutable fold-local F16/V2 native baseline, native logits argmax
protocol.comparisons: PAIRWISE_HISTORY, NEIGHBOR_READOUT, NEIGHBOR_MESSAGE constrained seed1; inherited native slot selection reference only, NOT rescoring corrected paths or promoted deployed models
protocol.joint_quality: ADE + 0.5 FDE; single candidate, not separate minima
protocol.selection_input: Existing native logits only; no future or GT-derived groups
protocol.classification: GT posthoc mutually exclusive six classes; good candidate must satisfy BOTH thresholds on the SAME path
protocol.data_policy: All 1516 samples, all20 candidates, no hand-filtering; thresholds only visual diagnostics, never experiment gates or tuning
protocol.preservation: All writes under this new directory except a final .memory update. Old files read-only, SHA audited. No training, GPU, test, new fold or external data
protocol.limitations: Repeated ETH development subset and one generator seed; descriptive counts not independent generalization or causal attribution. Unfinished cycle11 outputs excluded. Softmax of scores is not calibrated probability. Alternative futures not disproven by a single GT
